payload.title: Resolve current guidance and provenance for classifiers and desk editors
payload.description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a publication editor, I want both nomination and LLM triage to use appropriate current guidance through the shared resolver, so that news judgment does not depend on copied stale policy.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Resolve current guidance and provenance for classifiers and desk editors
  Scenario: Resolve applicable current guidance
    Given a publication and section with current mission, policies and editorial guidelines
    When classifiers nominate sections and an LLM desk editor performs triage
    Then each receives appropriate publication and section guidance through the shared resolver
    And each decision records context source identities, revisions and the context hash where available
    And narrower story or assignment instructions respect policy precedence
  Scenario: Required guidance is unavailable
    Given required policy is missing, contradictory in scope or unauthorized
    When triage is requested
    Then the unresolved condition is explicit
    And copied snapshots are not silently substituted as current policy
```

Reuse PPY-e081de and docs/editorial-context.md, not a new policy store or static prompt copy. Later implementation must verify actual classifier seed/rubric refresh and LLM context configuration capability and reconcile it with resolver semantics; existing source does not prove deployed support. Preserve required policy under context budgets and distinguish hosted current context from explicitly local Git seeds.
